# nano‑vLLM 知识图谱

## 1. 推理整体流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    P1["Prompt (输入文本)"] --> T1["Tokenizer (分词)"]
    T1 --> I1["Token IDs"]
    I1 --> E1["Embedding Layer"]
    E1 --> PF["Prefill (首次前向)"]
    PF --> DL["Decode Loop (生成下一个 token)"]
    DL --> L1["Logits (词表概率分布)"]
    L1 --> S1["Sampler (采样或取最高概率)"]
    S1 --> O1["Output Token Sequence"]
    O1 --> DL
    DL --> ST["Stop Token (结束符)"]
```

## 2. KV 缓存管理与虚拟内存
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    KV1["KV Cache Pool (预分配显存)"] --> AL1["Block Allocation"]
    AL1 --> LB1["Logical Block (请求的 token 切块)"]
    LB1 --> PB1["Physical Block (GPU 连续显存块)"]
    PB1 --> PT1["Page Table (逻辑 ↔ 物理映射)"]
    PT1 --> HT1["Hash Table (前缀 hash → block id)"]
    HT1 --> PC1["Prefix Cache (复用已计算 KV)"]
    PC1 --> RC1["Reference Count (引用计数)"]
    RC1 --> EV1["Eviction (ref=0 时释放)"]
```

## 3. 调度器与执行模型
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    AR1["Add Request (入队)"] --> RQ1["Request Queue (waiting)"]
    RQ1 --> SCH["Scheduler"]
    SCH --> PF1["Prefer Step (Prefill)"]
    SCH --> DC1["Decode Step"]
    PF1 --> BM1["Block Manager (分配 KV 块)"]
    DC1 --> BM1
    BM1 --> MR["Model Runner (运行模型)"]
    MR --> SL["Step Loop (循环调度)"]
    SL --> SCH
    SCH --> RQ2["Running Queue (执行中)"]
    RQ2 --> CMP["Request Completion"]
```

## 4. 关键优化技术概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CA1["Config Attention (显存虚拟化)"] --> UTIL["GPU Memory Utilization"]
    PC2["Prefix Caching"] --> UTIL
    CB1["Continuous Batching"] --> SCHOPT["Scheduler Optimizations"]
    SCHOPT --> UTIL
    FA1["Flash Attention"] --> UTIL
    TP1["Tensor Parallel"] --> UTIL
    PM1["Pin Memory"] --> UTIL
    MF1["Memory Fragmentation"] --> UTIL
```
